_comment: Helsinki (Helsingin päärautatieasema, Digitraffic HKI). Draft from OSM via Overpass (cached 2026-10-28), schema 2. Platforms 1-19 are tagged in OSM at ground level (no level tag); the station hall and Asematunneli are tagged indoor with levels 2, 1, 0 and -1 (OSM uses 0 for the street level here). Platforms H0018-H0021 at level -3 are the Pisararata reservation/ metro and are left out of the walking levels. Names from VR's/Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency's plans still to be checked; the owner's video covers the hall and platforms.
